'''Lao Statistics Bureau''' is the state agency charged with the collection and publication of statistics related to the economy, population and society of [[Laos]].<ref name=GHDX>{{cite web|url=http://ghdx.healthdata.org/organizations/lao-statistics-bureau |title=Lao Statistics Bureau |website=Global Health Data Exchange |publisher=University of Washington |accessdate=14 February 2017}}</ref>
